title.en: An Act Establishing a Pilot Project for Animal Industry in the Municipality of Binmaley, Province of Pangasinan, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Animal Industry, a pilot project for animal industry in the Municipality of Binmaley, Province of Pangasinan.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said pilot project during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19,1971.
